en.headline: HK Express cancels 10 Taiwan flights on Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: The budget carrier will scrap six Hong Kong–Taipei services and cancel or defer others to Taichung and Kaohsiung, offering free rebooking or refunds to affected passengers.
body: HK Express has cancelled 10 flights between Hong Kong and Taiwan on Friday as Super Typhoon Champi moves towards the island.

Six flights serving Taipei (UO112 to UO117) will be cancelled. Two flights to and from Taichung (UO172 and UO173) will also be cancelled, while two others are deferred to Saturday. Two Kaohsiung flights (UO134 and UO135) are cancelled and two are deferred to Saturday.

The airline said it is notifying affected passengers by email. Passengers may rebook free of charge for a new departure within two weeks of the original date, or claim a full refund for the unused portion of the ticket.
Hong Kong Airlines earlier cancelled its two Okinawa flights on Thursday. Other carriers said they are monitoring the storm, which is not expected to affect Hong Kong directly.

zh.headline: 香港快運周五取消10班台灣航班 因超強颱風薔琵逼近
zh.dek: 快運宣布取消六班往返台北航班，另有台中及高雄航班取消或改期至周六，受影響旅客可免費改期或退款。
body: 受超強颱風薔琵逼近台灣影響，香港快運宣布調整周五往返台灣的航班，合共取消10班。
六班往返香港及台北的航班（UO112至UO117）取消。往返台中的UO172及UO173取消，另兩班改期至周六；往返高雄的UO134及UO135取消，另兩班亦改期至周六。
航空公司正以電郵通知受影響旅客。旅客可免費改期至原定出發日期前後兩星期內的航班，或就未使用航段申請全額退款。
香港航空較早已取消周四兩班往返沖繩航班。其他航空公司表示正密切監察，天文台預期薔琵不會直接影響香港。
